subject: CS471
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering key firewall and network security concepts. The English selections are all highly-viewed, authoritative videos from well-known educational creators. The Arabic selections are also strong, sourced from popular regional tech channels, though one topic lacked a suitable candidate that met all quality criteria.

coverage.note: No candidate sufficiently covered both application-level and circuit-level gateways to explain the difference; available videos were either irrelevant, too general, or failed the minimum view count gate.

coverage.topic: Unified Threat Management (UTM) and Digital Immune System

videos.title: Stateful vs Stateless Firewalls - You NEED to know the difference
videos.topic_ar: آلية عمل جدار الحماية فاحص الحالة
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video clearly explains the mechanics of stateful firewalls by contrasting them with stateless ones, an effective pedagogical approach to address the core concept.

videos.title: Firewall Types Packet Filter, Application Gateway and Circuit Gateway Firewall
videos.topic_ar: الفرق بين بوابات مستوى التطبيق ومستوى الدائرة
videos.filter_reason: With over 200k views, this video from an engineering-focused channel clearly explains and differentiates between packet filtering, application-level, and circuit-level gateways, perfectly matching the topic.

videos.title: Firewall Implementation
videos.topic_ar: طبولوجيا جدران الحماية وهيكلية منطقة DMZ
videos.filter_reason: This video from a CISA instructor is highly relevant as it covers multiple firewall topologies including screened host, dual-homed, and subnet architectures, providing a comprehensive overview.

videos.title: MicroNugget: IDS vs. IPS
videos.filter_reason: This popular video from CBT Nuggets directly addresses the common confusion between IDS and IPS, clearly explaining the difference between passive detection and active prevention mechanisms.

videos.title: Firewall Types - CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 - 3.2

videos.topic_ar: الإدارة الموحدة للتهديدات ونظام المناعة الرقمي
videos.filter_reason: From the highly respected Professor Messer, this video explains UTM in the context of other modern firewalls, providing the necessary depth and comparison for a university-level understanding.

videos.title: شرح تفصيلي للفايروول - Firewall وأنواعه (جدار الحماية) بجرافيك احترافي
videos.topic_ar: آلية عمل جدار الحماية فاحص الحالة
videos.filter_reason: This is a very popular and professionally produced video that explains different firewall types, including a clear and well-animated section on stateful inspection.

videos.title: شرح شامل لل DMZ - Demilitarized Zone وطريقة تفعيله في راوتر المنزل
videos.topic_ar: طبولوجيا جدران الحماية وهيكلية منطقة DMZ
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video provides an excellent and visually clear explanation of DMZ architecture, which is a core component of modern firewall topologies.

videos.title: الفرق بين أنظمة منع التسلل وأنظمة كشف التسلل IPS and IDS
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly suited for the topic, as its title and content are dedicated to explaining the exact difference between IDS (detection) and IPS (prevention).
